# User Story Template

## Purpose:

This document is a template for our high level user stories.  The goal is to have a high level story that we can then convert into GitHub feature issues to complete (link the user story into the GitHub issues or project).  This will make working on tasks more transparent for team members and hopefully helps avoid confusion.

**Please Note**

1. Don't treat user stories as mini specification documents.
2. Treat a user story as a promise to have a conversation.

## User Story

<!-- 

## Examples:

As a Rigly Bidder, I want to bid on hashrate so that I can earn money from Bitcoin mining.

As a Rigly Auctioneer, I want to manage upcoming and past auctions.

## Tips for writing effective user stories:

1. Keep the user's perspective in mind and clearly articulate the value that the feature will provide to them.
2. Avoid specifying how the feature will be implemented. The development team will determine the best approach for implementing the feature based on their expertise and the constraints of the project.
3. Use the template "As a [type of user], I want [accomplish some goal] so that [a reason]" to ensure that the user's perspective and motivation are clearly stated.
4. Use specific and concrete language to describe the feature and its benefits. Avoid vague or abstract language.

-->
